_comment: Config for nexus_checks.state_freshness. A governed state/kernel file is STALE when the newest git commit under any path it governs is more than tolerance_days newer than the state file's own newest commit. broken_reference_scan lists the state/kernel files whose inline `backtick path` references are checked against the actual tree. JSON, not YAML, on purpose: this repo parses TTL/routing YAML nowhere (steel_kernel.py hardcodes the same values in Python; the .yaml files are the human-readable mirror) and this checker is stdlib-only.

entries.note: repo-wide session state; RULE says read this first in any new session
kernel points at policy/router files and steel_kernel.py; it must track them
